groups.title: Rotating ring puzzles
groups.lede: Stacked rings that turn on their own: line them up to bring the picture back, on paper, a phone or a watch.

projects.name: Stakco Play
projects.desc: Daily ring puzzles in the browser and on Android: drag to turn a layer, double-tap to switch, beat the clock.

projects.name: Stakco Watch
projects.desc: Ring puzzles on the wrist: turn the Galaxy Watch bezel to rotate a layer until the face lines up.

parts.name: Stakco watch faces
parts.kind: Unity scenes and Galaxy Watch build

groups.title: Games you play with your body
groups.lede: Floor tiles that light, sound and buzz under your feet, and science sensors that turn heartbeat, light and warmth into game moves.

projects.name: iTiles Games
projects.desc: Memory, Chasing Lights and Music Orchestration for the iTiles floor tiles, in Unity and now the browser.

projects.name: Stakco iTiles
projects.desc: A Stakco ring puzzle you solve on foot: each tile you touch picks a layer or turns it.

projects.name: Kiwrious + iTiles
projects.desc: Science sensors drive the tiles: heart-rate challenges, UV alerts and temperature colour maps.

projects.name: Kiwrious Play
projects.desc: Scratch for science: plug in a Kiwrious sensor and children build games that react to live heart rate, UV, humidity and more.

groups.title: Games in the world around you
groups.lede: Play that leaves the screen: a dartboard in your room, art hidden at real places, and puzzles you turn by walking.

projects.name: DartsAR
projects.desc: Augmented-reality darts for iPhone and Android: a virtual board in your room, multiplayer, leg by leg.

projects.name: Geodex
projects.desc: A treasure hunt for places: walk closer and the static clears, stand on the spot and the art is yours.

parts.name: Geodex server
parts.kind: Worker + D1, web play and console

projects.name: Stakco on the move
projects.desc: Ring puzzles you solve by moving: each step turns a ring, or face a compass heading to line one up.

yearsNote: From each project's git history (first to last commit). Stakco Play includes the Unity simulator from 2023; Stakco Watch runs from the first watch-face commits (Feb 2024) to the Galaxy Watch app (Oct 2025); DartsAR uses 2018–2020, the years the game was out (the site repo's 2026 commit only moved its domain); stakco-play-android and stakco-audio-html5 have no git history and fall inside the Stakco Play range.
thumbsNote: Geodex loads its current og:image live through the Worker (/api/og), over a screenshot until it arrives. The rest use screenshots of the live sites (800×420). Stakco Watch and Stakco iTiles are drawn from og/thumbs.html: the watch is the watch-face prototype, the iTiles page needs real tiles to show a puzzle. Clock Puzzles' og:image currently 404s, so it uses a screenshot.
cardsNote: Cards show only things people use. Backends, earlier versions, prototypes and other platforms are listed as parts of their product (hover the parts chip). Stakco is Sankha's own (role mine). Clock Puzzles is left out at Sankha's request (2026-10-25). Left out: Gyro Shapes (shadow-play-html5) and Magic Bells (compass-driven music box) are toys rather than games, so they belong in sense / music. Kiwrious Play (play.kiwrious.com) also sits in learn.
